summary: Land acquisition compensation dispute; 'Blue Zone' status contested; relevant date for market valuation: notification issuance date; agricultural land potential conversion to residential use; reference to prior acquisitions for uniform valuation; sale exemplars at Rs.1047/sq.ft. considered vs awarded Rs.5/sq.ft.; failure to document 'Blue Zone' in acquisition award deemed fatal; municipal limits proximity establishes development potential; Reference Court findings upheld; High Court interference impermissible.
final_judgment: Civil appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; compensation awarded as per Reference Court determination.
